items.text: Introducing a fresh take on protection for your shipments
Set yourself up for success by registering for our InsureShield Online Portal fo
how do i register for the online portal?
screenshot of the registration step of insureshield online p
set up your account by visiting our registration page
enter your policy id, email address and zip code
select whether you’re the account holder, billing contact or claims contact
Once registered, you will have access to file claims, view claim status, and man
how do i insure my shipment?
To ensure your shipments are insured, you must declare a value for each package
enter the delivery address into your shipping software (ups worldship, campusship, etc.)
select the delivery service (ground, next day air, etc.)
enter the value of the package contents
Be sure to accurately declare the value of your package contents so you are prop
